At first she spoke softly, but the other members encouraged her. By the end of the month, she was helping a younger child choose books.

questions.q: Why did the association decide to keep weekly records?
o: To prove immediately that boats caused the change
To stop all fishing near the shore
To look for a pattern before choosing an action
To compare the price of different boats
questions.e: Des relevés réguliers peuvent faire apparaître une tendance.
questions.t: A fisherman noticed that the catch near the shore had become smaller. The village association discussed several possible causes, including weather and the number of boats. They agreed to record each week’s catch before deciding what to do. The chairperson said that one observation could not prove the cause, but regular records might reveal a pattern.

questions.q: What caution did the chairperson express?
o: One observation cannot prove the cause
questions.e: Une seule observation ne suffit pas pour prouver la cause.
questions.t: A fisherman noticed that the catch near the shore had become smaller. The village association discussed several possible causes, including weather and the number of boats. They agreed to record each week’s catch before deciding what to do. The chairperson said that one observation could not prove the cause, but regular records might reveal a pattern.

questions.q: Why did the students ask musicians to approve recordings?
o: To get permission before using their words
To teach them how to play
To choose which instruments to lend
questions.e: Ils demandaient l’accord des personnes avant d’utiliser leurs propos.
questions.t: The museum planned an exhibition about local music. Organizers invited musicians to lend instruments and explain how they were made. A student team recorded short interviews, but they asked each person to approve the recording before using it. The exhibition included the musicians’ words alongside photographs of the instruments.

questions.q: What appeared beside the musicians’ words?
questions.e: L’exposition associait les paroles à des photos d’instruments.

A student team recorded short interviews, but they asked each person to approve the recording before using it. The exhibition included the musicians’ words alongside photographs of the instruments.

questions.q: What did students do at the start of the study period?
questions.e: Chaque élève définissait un objectif pour l’heure.
questions.t: The school introduced a quiet study period before examinations. Students could choose any subject, but they had to set a goal for the hour. At the end, they wrote down what they had completed and what remained difficult. Teachers used these notes to suggest which lessons might need more review.

questions.q: How did teachers use the students’ notes?
o: To suggest topics for more review
questions.e: Les notes aidaient à choisir les leçons à revoir.

questions.q: What did the bakery do with safe leftover bread?
o: Sold it at a lower price
Used it to make new ovens
Kept it for a full month
questions.e: Le pain encore consommable était vendu moins cher.
questions.t: A small bakery tested a new way to reduce food waste. At closing time, workers listed bread that was still safe to eat and offered it at a lower price. They tracked how much was sold and how much remained. After a month, the owner changed the baking schedule so fewer loaves were left unsold.

questions.q: What change followed the month-long trial?
questions.e: Le propriétaire a ajusté les heures ou quantités de cuisson.

questions.q: What weakness did the group identify in its arrangement?
o: It had too many weekly meetings
It depended on only two account managers
Online buyers could not order baskets
questions.e: Le système dépendait fortement de deux personnes.
questions.t: A women’s group wanted to sell woven baskets online, but not every member had internet access. They chose two members to manage the account and agreed to share photographs and orders at weekly meetings. The arrangement worked until one manager became ill, so the group trained a third member as backup.

questions.q: Why did the group train a third member?
o: To provide backup if a manager was unavailable
questions.e: La troisième personne peut remplacer une responsable absente.

They chose two members to manage the account and agreed to share photographs and orders at weekly meetings. The arrangement worked until one manager became ill, so the group trained a third member as backup.

questions.q: What did the journalist do when sources disagreed?
o: She reported that the date was uncertain
She selected the newest source automatically
questions.e: Elle n’a pas prétendu connaître une date sans preuve.
questions.t: A student journalist interviewed a retired teacher about the history of the school. She checked the dates in old notebooks and compared them with a photograph that showed the original classroom. When two sources disagreed, she wrote that the date was uncertain instead of choosing one without evidence.

questions.q: Why did she compare different sources?
o: To check the reliability of the dates
To prove the teacher was wrong
questions.e: Elle comparait les sources pour vérifier les dates.
questions.t: A student journalist interviewed a retired teacher about the history of the school. She checked the dates in old notebooks and compared them with a photograph that showed the original classroom. When two sources disagreed, she wrote that the date was uncertain instead of choosing one without evidence.

questions.q: Who was allowed to open the pump?
o: The first person to report a problem
questions.e: Seuls les travailleurs formés pouvaient ouvrir la pompe.
questions.t: The village water committee set a rule for repairing the pump: anyone who noticed a problem should report it quickly, but only trained workers could open the machine. This reduced damage caused by untrained repairs. The committee also posted the repair contact near the well.

questions.q: What was the purpose of posting the repair contact?
o: Teach children to open the machine
questions.e: Le contact affiché permet de signaler rapidement une panne.
